verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents a concrete recall target (index auto-tuned for 90-100% recall, >90% with filters) and ships its own recall endpoint so users can measure recall themselves. Its latency claims ("low-latency queries to petabyte scale") carry no published latency figures or benchmark methodology in the evidence. A community commenter notes the introductory page contains substantial data, but no specific turbopuffer latency numbers are evidenced. missing for 10: published latency benchmarks (p50/p99 figures), documented benchmark methodology or datasets, independent corroboration of recall/latency numbers.
